summary: REQ-1/REQ-2/REQ-3 documentation and theming appear to be added, but the diff also implements substantial new application functionality (backend follow-request APIs, Internet Identity auth flow, dashboard/search UI) that was not explicitly requested and conflicts with the stated non-goal of not adding unspecified features.

hallucinated_features.description: Implemented Motoko backend data model and follow-request management APIs (create/approve/deny/get pending requests, plus many unrelated domain types like Employee/Policy/Post/Credential).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to (1) collect missing feature specifications, (2) confirm repo ingestion approach, and (3) define/apply a theme. It explicitly lists as a non-goal: implementing any new features not explicitly specified by the user.

hallucinated_features.description: Implemented frontend application screens and functionality for authentication, follow request inbox/actions, user search by Principal, dashboard stats, toasts, and polling via React Query.
hallucinated_features.reason: These are concrete product features beyond the requested deliverables (spec collection + ingestion plan + theme). They were not explicitly requested as implemented features in the BuildRequest and violate the 'Non-goals' constraint.
